title: Meeting with Grusch while he was undercover

tellings.quote: I met with Grush when he was still an undercover uh operative. Okay. And no one knew who he was. His bosses were the ones I was providing intel to

plain: A guest named Steven Greer says that in the years before 2023 he met David Grusch, who later went public with claims about hidden UFO programmes, while Grusch was still "an undercover operative" whom "no one knew". Greer adds that Grusch's bosses were the people he was passing information to. He tells Michels this as something he took part in, and if it is true, he was feeding information to the same people Grusch worked for before Grusch ever spoke out.
